byte[] jpegBytes = java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(java.nio.file.Paths.get(exif_jpeg));
byte[] exifData = null;

// Extract the APP1 (Exif) segment from the JPEG file
for (int i = 0; i < jpegBytes.length - 1; i++) {
    if (jpegBytes[i] == (byte) 0xFF && jpegBytes[i + 1] == (byte) 0xE1) {
        int length = ((jpegBytes[i + 2] & 0xFF) << 8) | (jpegBytes[i + 3] & 0xFF);
        if (i + 4 + length - 2 <= jpegBytes.length) {
            byte[] segment = new byte[length - 2];
            System.arraycopy(jpegBytes, i + 4, segment, 0, length - 2);
            if (segment.length >= 4 && segment[0] == 'E' && segment[1] == 'x' && segment[2] == 'i' && segment[3] == 'f') {
                exifData = segment;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.exif.Orientation orientation = null;
if (exifData != null) {
    orientation = net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.exif.ExifUtils.getOrientationFromExif(exifData);
}

// Fallback to a manually constructed val
